category_title: Students who use physical presence and threats to intimidate faculty
scenario_title: Physical intimidation and personal space invasion after hours
minimal_context: The student has stayed behind after an evening class to wait for the professor to be alone.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I see you stayed behind until all of the other students had left. What did you want to discuss?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Just stands there with his legs spread apart, staring at you.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you have a question about the evening class?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves closer and closer, invading your personal space.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I need to get going now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues moving closer, leaving you cornered and backed up against the wall with no immediate outlet.)
